name: spendlens
description: Local-only personal spending tracker for Revolut

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.demo: mkdir -p data && node scripts/demo-statement.ts > data/demo-statement.csv && echo "Wrote data/demo-statement.csv, import it from the app"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm run build
